newsitem.title: CHINA: Jinan Qingqi to list 230 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Jinan Qingqi to list 230 mln B shares.

text.p: Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co Ltd will list 230 million B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange on Tuesday, June 17, a company statement said on Thursday.
The Shanghai stock exchange has set the firm's B share listing code as 900946.SS, the statement said.
The shares were issued in early June in a private placement at 4.00 yuan ($0.482) each, raising net income of $105.7 million excluding issue costs, it added.
Proceeds will be used to upgrade the firm's technology in producing motorcycles and their spare parts.
B shareholders will enjoy a full year's dividend for fiscal year 1997 ending December 31, as approved by shareholders at an earlier meeting, the statement said.
With the B share issue, the company has a total of 971.82 million shares, it said.
B shares account for 23.67 percent of issued shares and domestic A shares comprise 22.97 million shares or 23.64 percent. The remaining shares are owned by the state and institutions.
The company posted a net profit of 256.392 million yuan for 1996 against 126.435 million yuan for 1995 and 110.367 million yuan for the previous year.
It has forecast a net profit of 408.424 million yuan for 1997.
All the figures are based on international accounting standards, the statement said.
